title: Switch the three entry use cases to the domain operations
outcome: Recording a rally, editing a rally and recording a substitution all write through the entry operations, and the application layer no longer reaches into the frontend module.
acceptanceCriteria: create-rally, update-rally and create-substitution call appendEntry or replaceEntry and no longer call update().
No file under src/applications/ imports from @/lib/features/, reducing the application layer's outward imports from three to one.
The statistics mutations in create-substitution and the statistics initialisation in create-set are deleted, since those values are now derived.
create-substitution still persists the lineup swap, written as a positional set alongside the appended entry.
